neighbours.label: the main verb ('is', 'are', 'as') that follows a long, multi-word subject phrase
fire: Eating well and sleeping eight hours every night are the best habits for health.
The man who founded the company in a garage forty years ago is retiring this spring.
Teaching young children to read with phonics and songs is a proven approach.
Every report submitted by the regional offices last quarter was reviewed twice.
The bridge that connects the two halves of the old city is closed for repairs.
Running a small bakery while raising three kids is harder than it looks.
The samples collected from the northern lakes in early spring are stored in ice.
Reducing emissions from cars, trucks and factories is the main goal of the plan.
quiet: Good habits are the best way to stay healthy every night.
Now he is retiring this spring after forty years.
Phonics is a proven approach for young children.
Today it was reviewed twice by the regional offices.
For now it is closed for repairs in the old city.
Honestly, baking is harder than it looks.
In spring they are stored in ice near the lakes.
Clearly, this is the main goal of the plan.

predictions: Fires on the copula after a long subject (clauses, conjoined gerunds); weaker after a one- or two-word subject.
notes: Early broad gate-closed pole (max 1.09). Probes: 'woman who was born ... ago is' 0.51, 'Losing weight and getting in shape are' 0.28, 'method described in the paper is' 0.22, 'Engineering enzymes by directed evolution is' 0.20; 'Dogs are loyal' -0.02, 'He is tall' -0.07, 'The boxes are' 0.08.
